description: Land Acquisition - Lands in Rawathawatta, Moratumulla, Willorawatta & Molpe, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, and claimants, but does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related matters.
